description: Stock Strata v0.2.12 with stock OMP 18.18.0; qwen3.8-flash-next-iq3_s on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, native Windows, text only, 262,144-token context. Stock setup-derived thresholds and flags; no hardware qualification or inherited receipts. Stock setup recommendations pinned: --parallel 4. Stock PLE direct reads pinned: --ple-io direct (the PLE table stays on direct SSD reads instead of the engine's automatic RAM residency). Stock engine environment pinned: gdn_stack, parallel_stack, select_two_pass (config env, stock values). Stock KV streaming off pinned: --kv-streaming off (KV stays in VRAM; no --kv-resident; batch row kernels stay on). Stock DFlash2 alone pinned: drafting=dflash2, packed offline from immutable inputs with 4 batch slots, one drafter per slot (engine 0.1.58 STRATA_BATCH_DF2); no pipeline windows and no silent MTP fallback. Stock engine 0.1.58 defaults: int8 prompt attention on these CUDA cards; tool-call recovery for declared tools is on by default (no tool_call_recovery key is written or pinned), alongside always-on quoted-call, missing-function-closer, lenient non-string JSON argument and stray-think-closer repairs; calls inside fenced or indented code stay text (Strata#4702, #4703) and tools the conversation already called count as declared (Strata#4663). The automatic expert cache keeps about 256 MiB more VRAM free (Strata#4474). With pinned batch slots, conversation parking keeps the shared prefix (Strata#4420). The pinned --ple-io direct reads replace automatic RAM PLE residency; the residency policy and its Strata#4518 lock release do not apply. The engine owns the all-experts-resident no-slot-loan default (STRATA_PF_W16_CACHE_MIB and STRATA_AUTO_NOBORROW are unpinned). Penalties count the reply (Strata#4590); Windows reports inherited low disk priority (Strata#4733); short arena RAM can fall back to file reads (Strata#4846), which start verification refuses. Bare --prefill auto may take 32768-token chunks; a RAM guard steps the ceiling to 16384 or 8192. STRATA_NV_CHUNK remains unpinned. K-quant MMQ prompt kernels are the default for K-quant experts only. An Auto start short of GPU memory is retried with no drafter, which start verification refuses. Stream writes have a 60 s timeout. The automatic FP16 weight cache is Linux-only. This profile pins stock's Linux GDN tensor-core prompt defaults; stock's Linux parallel-slot defaults; stock's opt-in exact two-pass QSA block selection for long prompts (STRATA_SELECT_TWO_PASS=1) through the config's env. These SM120 cards use the wide-up and stream-split hyper-connection reads, now with exact 5-8 token decode kernels; single-card layer-major prefill stays off. Stock OMP 18.18.0 selects replace editing for Qwen3.8; no edit-mode override is pinned. Hybrid CPU, 8 performance + 16 efficiency cores: stock --pool-workers 15.
